title: Order
description: Order details including status, execution, and conditional order settings.

id.description: The unique order ID assigned by BigONE.

amount.description: The original order amount (base asset quantity).

filled_amount.description: The amount that has been filled.

avg_deal_price.description: The average fill price of executed portions.

side.description: The order side. ASK = sell, BID = buy.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the order was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the order was last updated (ISO 8601).

stop_price.description: The trigger price for stop orders.

operator.description: The trigger condition for stop orders. GTE = triggered when price >= stop_price, LTE = triggered when price <= stop_price.

immediate_or_cancel.description: Whether this is an Immediate-or-Cancel order.

post_only.description: Whether this is a post-only order.
